div.div: Rules (CLAUDE.md). Lock order, QR deed: reporter_month → scan row → same_act → deed rows. Invite create: reporter_month → invites. Accept: reporter_month (reporter read unlocked first) → invite row → shared_device → pending deed row → same_act. Withdraw: invite row → same_act → deed row. Responses and event payloads never hold coordinates, phone numbers or free text, and never name a pending deed's doer. Non-owners get 404.
